title: Where Appearance Fails, Geometry Recognizes: A CAD-Free 3D Shape Prior That Complements Vision Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.04381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recognizing specific objects onboarded without a labeled training set recurs across manufacturing and service robotics, yet the conventional renderable prior, a computer-aided-design (CAD) model, is often unavailable. Two-dimensional capture supplies no shape prior, and frozen foundation features fail on geometrically similar, low-texture industrial parts. We ask what a short object-centric scan buys for recognition beyond the captured images themselves: each object is reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), summarized into a per-class shape prototype, and fused with frozen DINOv2 image features. First, the scan recovers the recognition value of CAD without CAD: geometry from RGB-D depth (on T-LESS), 3DGS, and CAD gives comparable recognition (tied on HOPE, within 1.6 points on T-LESS); 3DGS is only a convenient route to a point cloud. translated_title: 当外观失效时，几何来识别：一种无需CAD的3D形状先验，可作为视觉基础模型的补充
translated_abstract: 在制造和服务机器人领域，识别在没有标注训练集的情况下上线的特定物体是一个反复出现的任务，然而传统的可渲染先验——计算机辅助设计（CAD）模型——往往是不可获得的。二维采集无法提供形状先验，而冻结的基础模型特征在几何相似、低纹理的工业零件上表现不佳。我们探究一次简短的以物体为中心的扫描，除了所采集的图像本身之外，能为识别带来什么价值：每个物体用三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建，总结为每个类别的形状原型，并与冻结的DINOv2图像特征融合。首先，扫描在无需CAD的情况下恢复了CAD的识别价值：来自RGB-D深度（在T-LESS数据集上）、3DGS和CAD的几何信息可带来相当的识别效果（在HOPE数据集上持平，在T-LESS上差距在1.6个百分点以内）；3DGS只是获取点云的一条便捷途径。其次，其收益取决于形状本身的可辨识程度：在形状独特的家用物品上……
tldr: 该论文提出一种无需CAD模型的3D形状先验方法，通过3D高斯泼溅重建物体并融合冻结的DINOv2图像特征，证明简短的物体扫描可以达到与CAD先验相当的识别效果，在低纹理、几何相似的工业零件上弥补视觉基础模型的不足。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a CAD-free 3D shape prior that reconstructs objects via 3D Gaussian Splatting and fuses geometry prototypes with frozen DINOv2 features, showing that a short object scan achieves recognition comparable to CAD priors and complements vision foundation models on low-texture, geometrically similar industrial parts.
